_note: Lang fragment of the map-mod compatibility (docs/compat/maps.md). Merge into assets/nusmp/lang/en_us.json (not edited by this branch). Every message key below also has the same English text as its in-code fallback, so the game reads well before the merge. The biome and dimension names are what a minimap (Xaero's shows the biome name) and a world map display for the mod's biomes and dimensions; without them the raw key is shown.
message.nusmp.maps.hover: Click to copy the coordinates (%1$s). With Xaero's Minimap or World Map, click the grey text to add the waypoint.
message.nusmp.maps.hover_raw: Click to copy the Xaero's waypoint text.
message.nusmp.maps.ftb_warn: FTB Chunks lets players claim chunks in this mod's dimensions (%1$s). Add to its world config: %2$s. Details: /multiverse compat maps
message.nusmp.maps.player_only: Only a player has a position to share.
message.nusmp.maps.share.state: Waypoint lines: %1$s for you (server: %2$s). /multiverse waypoint share on|off|here|gate|return
message.nusmp.maps.share.on: You will get waypoint lines for places that matter (gates, rifts, safe rooms).
message.nusmp.maps.share.off: You will not get automatic waypoint lines any more.
message.nusmp.maps.share.no_gate: You do not know a Gate yet: walk through the Labyrinth Gateway first.
message.nusmp.maps.share.no_return: You have no Return Waypoint yet: stand somewhere in the dungeon first.
message.nusmp.maps.status.none: No map mod seen by this side. (A client-only map mod such as Xaero's is invisible to a dedicated server; the data below still works for it.)
message.nusmp.maps.status.colours: Block map colours: all %1$s custom blocks have a mapColor.
message.nusmp.maps.status.colours_bad: Block map colours: %1$s of %2$s custom blocks have NO mapColor (a vanilla map looks through them): %3$s. Re-run MapBlockColourGuardTest and fix the registration.
message.nusmp.maps.status.share: Waypoint lines: %1$s (raw Xaero's string %2$s, JourneyMap form %3$s, at most %4$s per player per minute). Players: /multiverse waypoint share on|off|here|gate|return.
message.nusmp.maps.status.ftb_ok: FTB Chunks: claims are blocked in this mod's dimensions (%1$s).
message.nusmp.maps.status.ftb_open: FTB Chunks WARNING: players can claim chunks in %1$s.
message.nusmp.maps.status.ftb_fix: Add to FTB Chunks' world config (%1$s): %2$s
message.nusmp.maps.status.ftb_unknown: FTB Chunks: its world config (%1$s) was not found, so claims in this mod's dimensions cannot be checked. Make sure it has: %2$s
message.nusmp.maps.status.ftb_absent: FTB Chunks: not loaded on this side.
message.nusmp.maps.status.test: Self-test: /multiverse mega selftest compat.maps. Details: docs/compat/maps.md.
message.nusmp.maps.status.ftb_block: FTB Chunks claim block: %1$s (config blockFtbClaims = %2$s, refused in: %3$s).
message.nusmp.maps.ftb_claims_blocked: Claiming is not allowed in the dungeons
